policy.routeModel: Store completed route-vector tariff cells for the exact PVP sequence. Where an operator publishes only per-PVP charges, derive and persist the allowed contiguous vector prices offline from verified cells; runtime must select one complete vector and must never sum components. policy.routeSelection: Only the single fastest route. No toll crossing on that route means free. Unknown mapping/price is unknown, never zero.

Table value is selected when passing each PVP, so routes whose PVP crossings straddle a time boundary require per-crossing time evaluation; do not combine them using departure time alone.
